transformations: analysis/analyze.py -> analysis/outputs/stats.json (Wilson CIs; Korn-Graubard CIs clustered by store; store-bootstrap CIs; Cohen kappa with its CI; screenshot-audit agreement)

fig6/scripts/make_fig6_panels.py (drawing only; no number is printed in the panels besides tick labels; every drawn value registered in panels/fig6_numbers.csv and checked by scripts/trace_fig6.py); fig6a_path.tex (TikZ line drawing of a, no numbers); fig6.tex (composite, tectonic)
fig6/scripts/make_caption_fig6.py (the caption carries every count and share; registry caption_fig6_numbers.csv)
uncertainty: b: Wilson 95% CIs (stores are the unit); c: Korn-Graubard 95% CIs clustered by store per vendor group, all vendors (the summary row): 95% CI from resampling stores (percentile bootstrap), in the caption; d: Wilson 95% CIs of the agreement share; Cohen kappa 95% CI in the caption. a: one store, exact counts (no interval).
missing_data: c: vendor groups with fewer than design.min_stores_row stores are omitted (none at present). d: the axis is truncated at 85% (ticks 85-100; stated in the caption); the screenshot-audit labels have not yet been checked by an independent human rater (stated in the caption).
